name: HumanTHOR
description: A simulation platform and benchmark that measures performance on human-robot collaboration tasks in a shared workspace.
reputation: A recent RSS 2024 benchmark with growing interest in the human–robot interaction and embodied AI communities for evaluating collaborative, shared-workspace behaviors.
notes: Simulation-based multimodal benchmark focused on HRI; not an LLM benchmark. Potential sim-to-real transfer issues and dependence on human-in-the-loop evaluation; dataset and tasks are recent so SOTA is not well established.
